soundness_flags.label: ass:average-loadings
soundness_flags.one_line: Xia and Yuan's cited inference condition is singular-space alignment plus an l1-size requirement for the loading and max-norm-consistent initial estimators, not the asserted Frobenius-average-scale condition alone.

soundness_flags.label: ass:dense-loadings
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited Xia–Yuan result does not support max-entry delocalization alone as its standard loading condition; it requires loading alignment with the unknown singular spaces.

soundness_flags.label: ass:sequential-randomization and all sequential definitions
soundness_flags.one_line: The filtration is indexed only by j in J={1,...,m}, but every sequential conditional law uses F_{i,j-1}, leaving F_{i,0} undefined.

soundness_flags.label: thm:simultaneous-bands / def:contrast-process
soundness_flags.one_line: The multiplier statistic divides by shat_g although the class permits r=min(n,m), in which case P_r(Zipw)=Zipw and shat_g=0 identically despite population variance nondegeneracy.
